correctness.rationale: General mirrored-embedding lemma is proved via increasing coordinatewise minimum of an embedding and its reflection. The exact iff weak-descent criterion follows from earliest-period matching in permutation powers. The θ-palindrome central indicator yields a transfer recurrence whose formal algebra gives the bivariate generating function for all m and k. Direct independent exhaustive mask enumeration agrees with separate coefficient extraction for 18 parameter sets (751,506 masks), plus the universal half-word lemma on 466 hosts. Finite experiments do not supply the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Exact all-half-length enumerator for infinitely many even alphabet sizes and power counts is a natural refinement of scattered reverse-complement reconstruction. The structural midpoint lemma applies to arbitrary symmetric hosts, whereas the explicit rational identity gives more than a routine numerical census. First nontrivial third-power correction quantifies a meaningful onset of repeated-period constraints. No practical application is asserted without evidence.
